# One Semaphore task alert (its Slack JSON, the webhook's body) as a ticket event: host,
# service, state, text. A task that ended in ERROR opens its template's ticket; its next
# SUCCESS closes it; anything else (WAITING_CONFIRMATION, an alert naming no template) is
# nothing. Rules as zammad-bridge's semaphore_to_checkmk (QUEUE-n8n-zammad.md).
import re

STATES = {"ERROR": "CRITICAL", "SUCCESS": "OK"}

body = (_items[0]["json"].get("body") if _items else None) or {}
attachments = body.get("attachments") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
first = attachments[0] if isinstance(attachments, list) and attachments and isinstance(attachments[0], dict) else {}
name = re.sub(r"^Task:\s*", "", str(first.get("title") or "")).strip()
text = str(first.get("text") or "").strip()
status = re.search(r"status:.*?\b([A-Z][A-Z_]+)\b", text)
state = STATES.get(status.group(1)) if status else None
if not name or not state:
    print("nothing to ticket: " + repr(str(first.get("title"))[:80]) + " " + repr(text[:120]))
    return []
detail = [text] + [str(f.get("title")) + ": " + str(f.get("value")) for f in first.get("fields") or []
                   if isinstance(f, dict) and f.get("value")]
if first.get("title_link"):
    detail.append(str(first["title_link"]))
return [{"json": {"source": "semaphore", "host": ("Semaphore " + name)[:250], "service": "semaphore",
                  "state": state, "text": "\n".join(detail)}}]

parameters.pythonCode:
# One Databasus notification (the webhook's body: heading, message) as a ticket event: host,
# service, state, text. A ticket per database and kind (backup, health, verification, WAL);
# a success closes it. WAL alerts have no recovery: their tickets are closed by hand. Rules
# as zammad-bridge's databasus_to_checkmk (QUEUE-n8n-zammad.md).
import re

# A heading's kind, first match wins ("backup verification failed" is a verification;
# "Physical WAL gap" is WAL, not a backup).
KINDS = (("verification", re.compile(r"verification", re.IGNORECASE)),
         ("WAL", re.compile(r"\bWAL\b")),
         ("health", re.compile(r"\bDB is\b")),
         ("backup", re.compile(r"\bbackup\b|^Physical (FULL|INCR)\b", re.IGNORECASE)))
OK = re.compile(r"^✅|\b(completed|passed|is online)\b")

body = (_items[0]["json"].get("body") if _items else None) or {}
heading = str(body.get("heading") or "").strip() if isinstance(body, dict) else ""
if not heading:
    print("nothing to ticket: no heading")
    return []
if heading == "Test message":
    key, state = "test", "WARNING"
else:
    kind = next((k for k, pattern in KINDS if pattern.search(heading)), heading)
    named = re.search(r'"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"', heading) or re.search(r"\[([^\]]+)\]", heading)
    key = kind + " " + named.group(1) if named and kind != heading else kind
    state = "OK" if OK.search(heading) else "CRITICAL"
message = str(body.get("message") or "").strip()
return [{"json": {"source": "databasus", "host": ("Databasus " + key)[:250], "service": "databasus",
                  "state": state, "text": "\n".join(x for x in (heading, message) if x)}}]

parameters.pythonCode:
# One Dockhand notification (Apprise's JSON: title, message, type) as a ticket event, as
# zammad-bridge's dockhand_to_checkmk did (QUEUE-n8n-zammad.md). It runs twice for a stack
# container's failure: on arrival, which asks for a hold, and after the hold ("held" set),
# which asks the Docker hosts again.
# Input: one item from "Gather Dockhand" or "Gather after the hold": note, docker (each
# Docker host's container list, a full response, or an error), held (the event put on hold,
# or nothing on arrival).
# Output: an event (host, service, state, text, repeat) with "hold" seconds, or nothing.
import re

HOLD = 180  # a redeploy's restarts are over well within it
# Docker sends a die after every kill or stop: their failure is held longer, and after it
# opens a ticket only if none is open (repeat "skip"), so one failure is one ticket.
FOLLOWED_BY_DIE = {"kill": 20, "stop": 20}
# Words that say a Dockhand event's state rather than what it's about.
STATE_WORDS = re.compile(r"\b(un)?healthy\b|\b(re)?start(ed|ing)?\b|\bstop(ped|ping)?\b|\bfail(ed|ure)?\b|"
                         r"\bsucce(ss|eded|ssful)\b|\berror\b|\bwarning\b|\bblocked\b|\bskipped\b|\bcompleted?\b",
                         re.IGNORECASE)
STATES = {"failure": "CRITICAL", "error": "CRITICAL", "warning": "WARNING", "success": "OK", "info": "OK"}


def stack_failure(name, hosts, running_ok=False):
    """Whether a container's failure is a ticket: (ticket, why). A stack's container that
    didn't exit 0 is; one gone, outside every stack, or exited 0 isn't, nor, with running_ok
    (after the hold), one running again. A host that can't be asked never drops a ticket."""
    found, unasked = [], 0
    for host in hosts:
        body = host.get("body") if isinstance(host, dict) and "error" not in host else None
        if isinstance(body, list):
            found += [c for c in body if isinstance(c, dict) and "/" + name in (c.get("Names") or [])]
        else:
            unasked += 1
    stack = [c for c in found if (c.get("Labels") or {}).get("com.docker.compose.project")]
    if stack:
        if running_ok and any(c.get("State") == "running" for c in stack):
            return False, "running again"
        if all(c.get("State") == "exited" and str(c.get("Status", "")).startswith("Exited (0)") for c in stack):
            return False, "exited 0, a normal finish"
        return True, ""
    if unasked:
        return True, f"{unasked} of {len(hosts)} Docker hosts couldn't be asked whether it belongs to a stack"
    return (False, "not part of a stack") if found else (False, "gone, removed by what started it")


g = _items[0]["json"] if _items else {}
hosts = g.get("docker") or []
held = g.get("held")
if held:
    ticket, why = stack_failure(held["container"], hosts, running_ok=True)
    if not ticket:
        print(held["host"] + ": no ticket after the hold, " + why)
        return []
    text = "\n".join(x for x in (held["text"], why) if x)
    return [{"json": dict(held, text=text, hold=0)}]

note = g.get("note") if isinstance(g.get("note"), dict) else {}
title = str(note.get("title") or "").strip()
message = str(note.get("message") or "").strip()
if not title:
    print("nothing to ticket: no title")
    return []
# A container event's message names the container ('Container "kea-dhcp4" die (image)'; its
# title is only "Container Die"); a stack's or an environment's names it ('Stack "netbox"
# deployed successfully', 'Environment "Local" is now reachable'), and their titles ("Git
# sync failed" and "Stack deployed"; "Environment offline" and "Environment online") never
# pair up alone, nor tell one stack or environment from another.
named = re.match(r'Container "([^"]+)" (\w+)', message)
other = re.match(r'(Stack|Environment) "([^"]+)" ', message)
if named:
    key = "Container " + named.group(1)
elif other:
    key = other.group(1) + " " + other.group(2)
else:
    key = re.sub(r"\s+([:,|])", r"\1", re.sub(r"\s+", " ", STATE_WORDS.sub("", title))).strip(" :-|") or title
    key = re.sub(r"^dockhand\b[\s:-]*", "", key, flags=re.IGNORECASE) or key  # titles often start "Dockhand"
state = STATES.get(str(note.get("type") or "info").lower(), "WARNING")
event = {"source": "dockhand", "host": ("Dockhand " + key)[:250], "service": "dockhand", "state": state,
         "text": "\n".join(x for x in (title, message) if x), "repeat": "note", "hold": 0, "container": ""}
if named and state != "OK":
    container, action = named.group(1), named.group(2).lower()
    ticket, why = stack_failure(container, hosts)
    if not ticket:
        print(event["host"] + ": no ticket, " + why)
        return []
    event.update(text="\n".join(x for x in (event["text"], why) if x), container=container,
                 hold=HOLD + FOLLOWED_BY_DIE.get(action, 0),
                 repeat="skip" if action in FOLLOWED_BY_DIE else "note")
    print(event["host"] + ": held " + str(event["hold"]) + "s before a ticket")
return [{"json": event}]

parameters.pythonCode:
# Alertmanager's webhook (its JSON's alerts) as one item per alert to ticket: its labels,
# annotations and status, its ticket's host, service and state, and, for an alert about a
# group still firing, the PromQL listing the members down ("query"; "" for none). Rules as
# zammad-bridge's to_checkmk (QUEUE-n8n-zammad.md, stage 4).
import json
import re

SEVERITIES = {"warning", "critical"}
NEVER = {"Watchdog", "InfoInhibitor"}
# The members behind an alert about a group: the PromQL selecting the ones down, and the
# alert's labels that narrow it. A workload's pods are matched by name. A target in a pod
# gets its pod's node; one outside the cluster (a Proxmox host) is kept as it is.
UP_DOWN = ("(up{%(m)s} == 0) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node)"
           ' max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{pod!=""}) or on (instance) (up{%(m)s} == 0)',
           ("job", "namespace", "service"))
PODS_NOT_READY = ('(kube_pod_status_ready{condition="true",%(m)s} == 0)'
                  " * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info)",
                  ("namespace",))
MEMBERS = {
    "TargetDown": UP_DOWN,
    "AlertmanagerClusterDown": UP_DOWN,
    "KubeDeploymentReplicasMismatch": PODS_NOT_READY,
    "KubeDeploymentRolloutStuck": PODS_NOT_READY,
    "KubeStatefulSetReplicasMismatch": PODS_NOT_READY,
    "KubeStatefulSetUpdateNotRolledOut": PODS_NOT_READY,
    "KubeDaemonSetRolloutStuck": PODS_NOT_READY,
    "KubeDaemonSetMisScheduled": PODS_NOT_READY,
    "KubeDaemonSetNotScheduled": PODS_NOT_READY,
}
WORKLOAD_LABELS = ("deployment", "statefulset", "daemonset")


# The ticket's host for an alert's labels. "Zammad: close what's over"'s Verdict holds the
# same function, character for character (scripts/tests/test_n8n_workflows.py checks).
# Labels that say what an alert is about, most specific first.
TARGET_LABELS = ("instance", "pod", "persistentvolumeclaim", "node", "job", "service")


def alert_host(labels):
    name = labels.get("alertname", "alert")
    target = next((labels[k] for k in TARGET_LABELS if labels.get(k)), "")
    namespace = labels.get("namespace", "")
    if namespace and namespace not in target:
        target = f"{namespace}/{target}" if target else namespace
    return f"{name} {target}".strip()[:250]


def members_query(labels):
    """The PromQL listing the members down behind this alert, or "" when it isn't about a
    group (or names no group to narrow to)."""
    if labels.get("alertname") not in MEMBERS:
        return ""
    template, keys = MEMBERS[labels["alertname"]]
    matchers = [f"{k}={json.dumps(labels[k])}" for k in keys if labels.get(k)]
    if (template, keys) == PODS_NOT_READY:
        workload = next((labels[k] for k in WORKLOAD_LABELS if labels.get(k)), "")
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9.]*[a-z0-9])?", workload):
            return ""
        matchers.append(f'pod=~"{workload}-.*"')
    if not matchers:
        return ""
    return template % {"m": ",".join(matchers)}


body = (_items[0]["json"].get("body") if _items else None) or {}
alerts = body.get("alerts") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
out = []
for a in alerts if isinstance(alerts, list) else []:
    labels = a.get("labels") if isinstance(a, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(labels, dict) or labels.get("severity") not in SEVERITIES or labels.get("alertname") in NEVER:
        continue
    resolved = a.get("status") == "resolved"
    out.append({"json": {"labels": labels, "annotations": a.get("annotations") or {}, "status": a.get("status"),
                         "host": alert_host(labels), "service": labels.get("alertname", "alert"),
                         "state": "OK" if resolved else str(labels.get("severity", "warning")).upper(),
                         "query": "" if resolved else members_query(labels)}})
print(str(len(out)) + " alert(s) to ticket of " + str(len(alerts) if isinstance(alerts, list) else 0))
return out
